spec.description: Network Operation Dashboard — Jawa Timur Availability Monitoring

PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN.description: Exact public HTTPS origin for cookie-origin validation

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated public hostnames accepted by the API

DASHBOARD_SESSION_SECRET.description: Required base64 secret with at least 32 random bytes

DASHBOARD_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.description: Fixed dashboard session lifetime in seconds

SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Require HTTPS-only dashboard cookies in production

N8N_API_KEY.description: Required shared key for the n8n alert webhook

N8N_MAP_API_KEY.description: Required read-only key for N8N static map sector exports

REDIS_URL.description: Private Redis connection string from the Redis service

OVERVIEW_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: Home overview Redis TTL in seconds

FILTER_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: Global filters and latest-period Redis TTL in seconds

APP_ENV.description: Application environment; must be production for this template
